name: kidboard
description: Icon-first family calendar and meal plan for a wall-mounted kiosk tablet.

scripts.prepare: node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('.git')?0:1)" && lefthook install || echo "skipping lefthook install"

CAL_KINDER_URL.description: Secret iCal address of the calendar with id `kinder` (Google Calendar: Settings > calendar > **Secret address in iCal format**). One `CAL_<ID>_URL` per calendar in `KIDBOARD_CONFIG`; see [docs/DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/FinkeFlo/kidboard/blob/main/docs/DEPLOY.md).

CAL_ESSEN_URL.description: Secret iCal address of the meal plan calendar with id `essen`. Never share it.

KIDBOARD_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: API access token: a long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Open the board once as `https://<worker>/?key=<token>`. Must not contain `REPLACE_ME` (the API refuses it).

KIDBOARD_CONFIG.description: Settings as single-line JSON (children, calendars, time zone, ...). Template: `config.example.json`, options: `docs/CONFIG.md`. Its calendar ids must match the `CAL_<ID>_URL` secrets.

KIDBOARD_CACHE.description: KV namespace for the calendar cache. Created automatically; keep the default.
